```cpp
void UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::OpenFilteredAnimSequencePicker(USkeletalMesh* FilterSkeletalMesh, TFunction<void(const TArray<UAnimSequence*>&,int32 LODIndex)> OnAssetsPicked)
{
	if (!FilterSkeletalMesh || !FilterSkeletalMesh->GetSkeleton()) return;
	int32 MaxLODCount = FilterSkeletalMesh->GetNumSourceModels(); 
	FString TargetSkeletonObjectPath = FilterSkeletalMesh->GetSkeleton()->GetPathName();
	FText Title = NSLOCTEXT("FAnimToTextureGeneratorModule","Title_SelectAnimSequence", "Select Animation Sequences (Multi-Select)");
	auto LODKey =  FilterSkeletalMesh->GetPackage()->GetPersistentGuid();
	
	
	TSharedRef<SWindow> PickerWindow = SNew(SWindow)
		.Title(Title)
		.ClientSize(FVector2D(800, 600));

	PickerWindow->SetContent(
		SNew(SAnimSequencePicker)
		.TargetSkeletonObjectPath(TargetSkeletonObjectPath)
		.MaxLODCount(MaxLODCount)
		.DefaultIndex(G_LODMap.FindOrAdd(LODKey,0))
		.OnAssetsPicked([OnAssetsPicked, PickerWindow,LODKey](const TArray<FAssetData>& Selected,const int32 LODIndex)
		{
			PickerWindow->RequestDestroyWindow();
			TArray<UAnimSequence*> SelectedAnimSequences;
			for (auto Asset : Selected)
			{
				if (auto AnimSequence = Cast<UAnimSequence>(Asset.GetAsset()))
					SelectedAnimSequences.Add(AnimSequence);
			}
			OnAssetsPicked(SelectedAnimSequences,LODIndex);
			G_LODMap.Add(LODKey,LODIndex);
		})
	);
	FSlateApplication::Get().AddModalWindow(PickerWindow, nullptr);
	
}

void UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::ShowSimpleSuccessToast(const FString& Message,float Duration)
{
	FNotificationInfo Info(FText::FromString(Message));
	Info.ExpireDuration = Duration;
	Info.bUseSuccessFailIcons = false; 
	Info.FadeInDuration= 3.5;
	FSlateNotificationManager::Get().AddNotification(Info);
}

UClass* UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::GetClass()
{
	return FindObject<UClass>(nullptr,TEXT("/Script/AnimToTextureEditor.AnimToTextureBPLibrary"));
}

UStaticMesh* UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::InvokeConvertSkeletalMeshToStaticMesh(USkeletalMesh* SkeletalMesh,
	const FString& NamePrefix, const int32 LODIndex)
{
	UClass* BPLibraryClass = GetClass();
	if (!BPLibraryClass)
	{
		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("[InvokeConvert] 无法找到 AnimToTextureBPLibrary 类！"));
		return nullptr;
	}
	UFunction* Function = BPLibraryClass->FindFunctionByName(TEXT("ConvertSkeletalMeshToStaticMesh"));
	if (!Function)
	{
		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("[InvokeConvert] 无法找到函数 ConvertSkeletalMeshToStaticMesh"));
		return nullptr;
	}
	struct FConvertSkeletalMeshToStaticMeshParms
	{
		USkeletalMesh* SkeletalMesh;
		FString NamePrefix;
		int32 LODIndex;
		UStaticMesh* ReturnValue;
	};

	FConvertSkeletalMeshToStaticMeshParms Parms;
	Parms.SkeletalMesh = SkeletalMesh;
	Parms.NamePrefix = NamePrefix;
	Parms.LODIndex = LODIndex;
	Parms.ReturnValue = nullptr;

	BPLibraryClass->GetDefaultObject()->ProcessEvent(Function, &Parms);

	return Parms.ReturnValue;
}

bool UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::InvokeAnimationToTexture(UAnimToTextureDataAsset* DataAsset)
{
	
	UClass* BPLibraryClass = GetClass();
	if (!BPLibraryClass)
	{
		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("[InvokeAnimationToTexture] 无法找到 BPLibrary 类"));
		return false;
	}
	UFunction* Function = BPLibraryClass->FindFunctionByName(TEXT("AnimationToTexture"));
	if (!Function)
	{
		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("[InvokeAnimationToTexture] 无法找到函数 AnimationToTexture"));
		return false;
	}
	struct FAnimationToTextureParms
	{
		UAnimToTextureDataAsset* DataAsset;
		bool ReturnValue; 
	};

	FAnimationToTextureParms Parms;
	Parms.DataAsset = DataAsset;
	Parms.ReturnValue = false; 

	BPLibraryClass->GetDefaultObject()->ProcessEvent(Function, &Parms);

	return Parms.ReturnValue; 
}

static TArray<IAssetEditorInstance*> UE57Older_GetAllOpenEditors(UAssetEditorSubsystem*& AssetEditorSubsystem,const TArray<UObject*>& AllAssets)
{
	TArray<IAssetEditorInstance*> MeshEditors;
 
	for (UObject* Asset : AllAssets)
	{
		if (Asset->IsA<USkeletalMesh>())
		{
			if (IAssetEditorInstance* EditorInstance = AssetEditorSubsystem->FindEditorForAsset(Asset, false))
			{
				MeshEditors.Add(EditorInstance);
			}
		}
	}
	return MeshEditors;
}


USkeletalMesh* UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::FindActiveSkeletalMesh()
{
	
	if (UAssetEditorSubsystem* AssetEditorSubsystem = GEditor->GetEditorSubsystem<UAssetEditorSubsystem>())
	{
		TArray<UObject*> AllAssets = AssetEditorSubsystem->GetAllEditedAssets();
		
		TArray<IAssetEditorInstance*> EditorInstances;
		#if UE_VERSION_OLDER_THAN(5,7,0)
				EditorInstances = UE57Older_GetAllOpenEditors(AssetEditorSubsystem, AllAssets);
		#else
				EditorInstances = AssetEditorSubsystem->GetAllOpenEditors();
		#endif
		
		
		
		if (EditorInstances.IsEmpty())return nullptr;
		EditorInstances.Sort([]( auto& A,auto& B){ return A.GetLastActivationTime() > B.GetLastActivationTime();});
		IAssetEditorInstance* First = EditorInstances[0];
		
		bool bIsFirst = true;
		for (int i = 1; i < EditorInstances.Num(); i++)
		{
			if (!FMath::IsNearlyEqual(First->GetLastActivationTime(), EditorInstances[i]->GetLastActivationTime()))
			{
				bIsFirst = false;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (bIsFirst)
		{
			for (int i=AllAssets.Num();i-->0;)
			{
				if (auto SkeletalMesh =Cast<USkeletalMesh>(AllAssets[i]))
					return SkeletalMesh;
			}
			 return nullptr;
		}
		
		for (UObject* Asset : AllAssets)
		{
			if (auto SkeletalMesh = StaticCast<USkeletalMesh*>(Asset))
			{
				IAssetEditorInstance* EditorInstance = AssetEditorSubsystem->FindEditorForAsset(Asset,false);
				if (EditorInstance && First == EditorInstance )
					return SkeletalMesh;
			}
		}
		
	}
	return nullptr;
}




//创建材质节点（材质属性节点）
UMaterialExpressionMakeMaterialAttributes* UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::CreateMakeMaterialAttributesExpression(UMaterial* Material)
{
	// if (!Material)return;
	auto NewExpression = UMaterialEditingLibrary::CreateMaterialExpression(Material,UMaterialExpressionMakeMaterialAttributes::StaticClass());
	return Cast<UMaterialExpressionMakeMaterialAttributes>(NewExpression);
}

// 创建材质函数节点
UMaterialExpression* CreateMaterialFunctionCall(UMaterial* Material, UMaterialFunction* MaterialFunction)
{
	auto NewExpression = UMaterialEditingLibrary::CreateMaterialExpression(Material, UMaterialExpressionMaterialFunctionCall::StaticClass());
	if (auto* FunctionCall = Cast<UMaterialExpressionMaterialFunctionCall>(NewExpression))
	{
		FunctionCall->MaterialFunction = MaterialFunction;
		FunctionCall->UpdateFromFunctionResource();
		
		#if UE_VERSION_OLDER_THAN(5,7,0)
			if (auto MaterialAttributeLayers = Cast<UMaterialExpressionMaterialAttributeLayers>(
				UMaterialEditingLibrary::CreateMaterialExpression(Material,UMaterialExpressionMaterialAttributeLayers::StaticClass())))
			{
				if (auto LayerFunction =LoadObject<UMaterialFunctionInterface>(nullptr,TEXT("/Script/Engine.MaterialFunctionMaterialLayer'/AnimToTexture/Materials/ML_BoneAnimation.ML_BoneAnimation'")))
				{
					MaterialAttributeLayers->DefaultLayers.Layers[0] = LayerFunction;
					FunctionCall->GetInput(1)->Connect(0, MaterialAttributeLayers);
				}
			}
					
		#endif
		
		return FunctionCall;
	}

	return nullptr;
}




void UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::ConnectToMaterialAttribute(UMaterial* Material,UMaterialFunction* MaterialFunction)
{

	if (!Material)
	{
		UE_LOG(LogTemp,Error,TEXT("材质并不存在！"))
		return;
	}
	
	if (Material->bUseMaterialAttributes)
	{
		FExpressionInput* MaterialAttributesInput= Material->GetExpressionInputForProperty(MP_MaterialAttributes);
		if (auto NewExpression = CreateMaterialFunctionCall(Material,MaterialFunction))
		{
			if (!MaterialAttributesInput->IsConnected()){
				
				UE_LOG(LogTemp,Error,TEXT("找不到MaterialAttributes节点的连接点"));
				return;
			}
			Material->Modify();
			NewExpression->GetInput(0)->Connect(0,MaterialAttributesInput->Expression);
			MaterialAttributesInput->Connect(0,NewExpression);
			Material->PostEditChange();
		}
					
		return;
	}

	TArray<ConnectedInfo> ExpressionInputs;
	GetConnectedExpressionInputInfoForProperty(Material,ExpressionInputs);
	UMaterialExpressionMakeMaterialAttributes* MaterialAttributesNode = CreateMakeMaterialAttributesExpression(Material);
	for (auto ExpressionInfo : ExpressionInputs)
	{
		auto ExpressionInput = ExpressionInfo.ExpressionInput;
		FExpressionInput* ToInput = GetExpressionInput(MaterialAttributesNode,ExpressionInfo.Property);
		if (ToInput && ExpressionInput->OutputIndex != INDEX_NONE)
		{
			ToInput->Connect(ExpressionInput->OutputIndex, ExpressionInput->Expression);
		}
	}
	
	// 创建材质函数节点	
	Material->bUseMaterialAttributes = true;
	if (auto NewExpression = CreateMaterialFunctionCall(Material,MaterialFunction))
	{
		Material->Modify();
		NewExpression->GetInput(0)->Connect(0,MaterialAttributesNode);
		UMaterialEditingLibrary::ConnectMaterialProperty(NewExpression, TEXT(""), MP_MaterialAttributes);
		Material->PostEditChange();
	}

}


FExpressionInput* UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::GetExpressionInput( UMaterialExpressionMakeMaterialAttributes* Exp, EMaterialProperty InProperty)
{
	switch (InProperty)
	{
	case MP_BaseColor: return &Exp->BaseColor;
	case MP_Specular: return &Exp->Specular;
	case MP_Normal: return &Exp->Normal;
	case MP_Tangent: return &Exp->Tangent;
	case MP_Metallic: return &Exp->Metallic;
	case MP_Roughness: return &Exp->Roughness;
	case MP_Anisotropy: return &Exp->Anisotropy;
	case MP_AmbientOcclusion: return &Exp->AmbientOcclusion;
	case MP_EmissiveColor: return &Exp->EmissiveColor;
	case MP_Opacity: return &Exp->Opacity;
	case MP_OpacityMask: return &Exp->OpacityMask;
	case MP_SubsurfaceColor: return &Exp->SubsurfaceColor;
	case MP_WorldPositionOffset: return &Exp->WorldPositionOffset;
	case MP_Displacement: return &Exp->Displacement;
	case MP_ShadingModel: return &Exp->ShadingModel;
	case MP_Refraction: return &Exp->Refraction;
	case MP_PixelDepthOffset: return &Exp->PixelDepthOffset;
	case MP_CustomizedUVs0: return &Exp->CustomizedUVs[0];
	case MP_CustomizedUVs1: return &Exp->CustomizedUVs[1];
	case MP_CustomizedUVs2: return &Exp->CustomizedUVs[2];
	case MP_CustomizedUVs3: return &Exp->CustomizedUVs[3];
	case MP_CustomizedUVs4: return &Exp->CustomizedUVs[4];
	case MP_CustomizedUVs5: return &Exp->CustomizedUVs[5];
	case MP_CustomizedUVs6: return &Exp->CustomizedUVs[6];
	case MP_CustomizedUVs7: return &Exp->CustomizedUVs[7];
	case MP_CustomData0: return &Exp->ClearCoat;
	case MP_CustomData1: return &Exp->ClearCoatRoughness;
	default: break; 
	}

	return nullptr;
}


void UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::GetConnectedExpressionInputInfoForProperty(UMaterial* Material, TArray<ConnectedInfo>& Results)
{
	for (int32 i = 0; i < static_cast<int32>(EMaterialProperty::MP_MAX); ++i)
	{
		EMaterialProperty Prop = static_cast<EMaterialProperty>(i);
		if (Prop == EMaterialProperty::MP_MAX) continue;
		FExpressionInput* Input = Material->GetExpressionInputForProperty(Prop);
		if (Input && Input->IsConnected())
		{
			ConnectedInfo Info;
			Info.ExpressionInput = Input;	
			Info.Property = Prop;
			Results.Add(Info);
		}
	}
}


void UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::OpenDirectoryDialog(const FString& DefaultFolder,TFunction<void(const FString&)> OnPathConfirmed)
{
	FString* SelectedPath = &G_LastSelectedPath;
    TSharedPtr<FString> InputText = MakeShared<FString>(DefaultFolder);
    FContentBrowserModule& ContentBrowserModule = FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked<FContentBrowserModule>("ContentBrowser");
    FPathPickerConfig Config;
    Config.DefaultPath = *SelectedPath;
    Config.OnPathSelected = FOnPathSelected::CreateLambda([SelectedPath](const FString& NewPath)
    {
        *SelectedPath = NewPath;
    });

	
    TSharedRef<SWindow> Window = SNew(SWindow)
        .Title(LOCTEXT("SelectSavePath","Select Save Path"))
        .ClientSize(FVector2D(480, 500));

    Window->SetContent(
        SNew(SVerticalBox)
        + SVerticalBox::Slot()
        .FillHeight(0.8f)
        
        .Padding(5)
        [
            ContentBrowserModule.Get().CreatePathPicker(Config)
        ]
        + SVerticalBox::Slot()
		.AutoHeight()
		.Padding(5)
		[
			SNew(SHorizontalBox)
			+ SHorizontalBox::Slot()
			.FillWidth(1.0f)
			.Padding(2)
			[
				SNew(STextBlock)
				.Text_Lambda([SelectedPath]() { return FText::FromString(*SelectedPath); })
			]
		]
        + SVerticalBox::Slot()
        .AutoHeight()
        .Padding(5)
        [
            SNew(SHorizontalBox)
            + SHorizontalBox::Slot()
            .FillWidth(0.8f)
            .Padding(2)
            [
                SNew(SEditableTextBox)
                .Text_Lambda([InputText]() { return FText::FromString(*InputText); })
                .OnTextChanged_Lambda([InputText](const FText& NewText) { *InputText = NewText.ToString(); })
                .HintText(LOCTEXT("InputSubDirectionOrName","Input subdirectory or name"))
            ]
        	
            // 确定按钮
            + SHorizontalBox::Slot()
            .AutoWidth()
            .Padding(2)
            [
            	
                SNew(SButton)
                .Text(LOCTEXT("Plugin_Ok_Btn","OK"))
                .OnClicked_Lambda([Window, SelectedPath, InputText, OnPathConfirmed]()
                {
					FString FinalPath = FPaths::Combine(*SelectedPath, *InputText);
                    FString ErrorMsg;
                    if (!IsValidContentPath(FinalPath, *InputText, ErrorMsg))
                    {
                        FMessageDialog::Open(EAppMsgType::Ok, FText::FromString(ErrorMsg));
                        return FReply::Handled();
                    }

                    Window->RequestDestroyWindow();
                    if (OnPathConfirmed)
                    {
                        OnPathConfirmed(FinalPath);
                    }

                    return FReply::Handled();
                })
            ]
            + SHorizontalBox::Slot()
            .AutoWidth()
            .Padding(2)
            [
            	
                SNew(SButton)
                .Text(LOCTEXT("Plugin_No_Btn","Cancel"))
                .OnClicked_Lambda([Window]()
                {
                    Window->RequestDestroyWindow();
                    return FReply::Handled();
                })
            ]
        ]
    );
	
    FSlateApplication::Get().AddModalWindow(Window, nullptr);
}




bool UAnimToTextureGeneratorLibrary::IsValidContentPath(const FString& FinalPath,const FString& InputPath, FString& Error)
{
	
	
	// 基础非空检查
	if (InputPath.IsEmpty()||InputPath.TrimStartAndEnd().IsEmpty())
	{
		
		Error = LOCTEXT("Valid_Info_001","Directory name cannot be empty.").ToString();
		return false;
	}

	//检查首尾是否有空格
	if (InputPath.StartsWith(TEXT(" ")) || InputPath.EndsWith(TEXT(" ")))
	{
		
		Error = LOCTEXT("Valid_Info_002","Directory name cannot start or end with spaces.").ToString();
		return false;
	}
	

	// 2. 禁止包含斜杠 (防止路径穿越)
	if (InputPath.Contains(TEXT("/")) || InputPath.Contains(TEXT("\\")))
	{
		Error = LOCTEXT("Valid_Info_003","Directory name cannot contain slashes (/ or \\).").ToString();
		return false;
	}

	// 非法字符检查 (空格、标点、特殊符号)
	// 遍历字符串中的每一个字符
	for (const TCHAR Char : InputPath)
	{
		// 禁止空格
		if (FChar::IsWhitespace(Char))
		{
			Error = FText::Format(LOCTEXT("Valid_Info_004", "Directory name cannot contain spaces: '{0}'"), Char).ToString();
			return false;
		}

		// 如果允许下划线，需要特判
		if (Char != TEXT('_') && FChar::IsPunct(Char))
		{
			Error =FText::Format(LOCTEXT( "Valid_Info_005", "Directory name contains invalid symbols: '{0}'"), Char).ToString();
			return false;
		}

		// 禁止控制字符 (不可见字符)
		if (FChar::IsControl(Char))
		{
			Error =FText::Format(LOCTEXT( "Valid_Info_006", "Directory name contains invalid control characters: '{0}'"), Char).ToString();
			return false;
		}
	}
	

	// 检查 FinalPath (组合后的路径) 是否符合 UE 资产命名规范
	if (!FPackageName::IsValidLongPackageName(FinalPath, true))
	{
		Error =LOCTEXT( "Valid_Info_007", "Generated path contains invalid characters or has an incorrect format.").ToString();
		return false;
	}

	//检查路径是否以数字开头
	if (FChar::IsDigit(InputPath[0]))
	{
		Error =LOCTEXT("Valid_Info_008", "Directory name cannot start with a number.").ToString();
		return false;
	}

	return true;
	
}




#undef LOCTEXT_NAMESPACE




```

## 流程图03

```mermaid
flowchart TD
```

## LaTeX 数学公式

行内公式：质能方程 $E = mc^2$，欧拉恒等式 $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$。

块级公式（二次求根公式）：

$$
x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}
$$

| --- | --- |
| 表格 | ✅ |
| 任务清单 | ✅ |
| 代码高亮 | ✅ |
| 引用块 | ✅ |
| 数学公式 | ✅ |
| 流程图 | ✅ |
